items: 英文：中等、中等、中等、中等
key_values.label: 語文條件
key_values.text: 英文：中等、中等、中等、中等

key_values.label: 工作技能
key_values.text: 韌體工程開發、韌體程式設計

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
【Essential Qualifications & Experiences】
a) 1-5 years+ of BMC/OpenBMC firmware experience.
b) Good C/C++ coding skills, including well design concepts and code tracing skill.
c) Well understanding of the principles of Linux operation system, kernel, application
d) Well understanding of BMC IPMI 2.0
e) Knowledge in Redfish (Restful API) is a plus
f) Independently porting skill of BMC to custom HW or algorithm.
g) Ability to read schematics
h) Experience of participating at least one whole server project cycle.
i) Bachelor or Master in Electronics, computing, software engineering or similar
【Personality】
- Enjoy in coding, debugging, and learning new technical knowledge
- Pragmatic but not stubborn
- Patient and enthusiasm in work
- Logicality and communication skill
- Teamwork and selfless contribution
